trigger_condition.value_trigger: Empty tensor data created with torch.zeros(())
trigger_condition.state_trigger: In-place operation after scalar constant creation
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Model contains a 0-dimensional constant produced by torch.zeros(()) and then mutated by an in-place operation (e.g., y += x) during torch.onnx.export.

bug_oracle.description: Exporting a model that creates a 0-dim tensor with torch.zeros(()) and then applies an in-place operation such as y += x.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary tensor shapes between 0-dimensional scalar and small tensors; vary constant factory values (zeros, ones, empty) used before in-place ops.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct 0-dimensional scalar tensors with torch.zeros(()), torch.ones(()), or torch.empty(()) and export them as graph constants.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force in-place mutation of the scalar constant (for example, y += x) and vary the in-place operation type.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Create a scalar constant tensor, apply an in-place operation that consumes it, then export the model with torch.onnx.export.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Treat any export exception or any produced ONNX graph that fails an ONNX checker/model validation as a bug signal.
